status_why: The Board's JSON endpoints answered scripts.
office: the District of Columbia Board of Elections
system: State-built (District of Columbia Board of Elections): electionresults.dcboe.org, a React app over JSON endpoints with a SignalR live channel; Cloudflare in front.

results_page.label: District of Columbia Board of Elections: election results
results_page.source: answered one request with the kit's User-Agent (N4, 2026-10-10)

election.how_to_find: electionResults/getElectionResultsId (run_night.py discover) in late October for the Nov 3 UrlText.

feeds.address: https://electionresults.dcboe.org/electionResults/getElectionResultsId (list: ElectionResultsId, ElectionDate, UrlText e.g. '2024-General-Election', IsLive, HasPublishedRCV); /electionResults/getElectionInfo/<UrlText> (PrecinctsCounted, TotalPrecincts, ElectionResultsTypeName, LastUpdated, IsLive, CSV/XML/PDF links); /cityWide/getCityWide/<UrlText> (every contest's totals); /cityWide/getWardPrecinct/<UrlText>; /citywide/GetANC/<UrlText>; /electionResults/getAllParties
feeds.updates: Live on election night (SignalR push to the page; IsLive flag); the JSON can be polled.
feeds.note: getElectionInfo/2024-General-Election answered 200 JSON to a script on 2026-10-09 (server cloudflare). The page carries Cloudflare's passive bot-detection script, but plain requests were served.

feeds.updates: Certified files after the canvass; election-night files may appear under another name.
feeds.note: Seen as links on the 2024 general page in the Browser pane.

races_in_feed: Delegate to Congress, shadow senator and representative, Mayor, Council chair and members, Attorney General, State Board of Education, Advisory Neighborhood Commissioners (single-member districts), initiatives. 2026 is the first general with ranked-choice voting under Initiative 83 for some offices (the site carries a HasPublishedRCV flag).
local: Not applicable (one jurisdiction; wards and ANCs are in the same feed).
how_counted: The Board posts counts through the night. Ranked-choice rounds, where they apply, are published later.
count_order: No vote-type split in the summary; the certified CSV may split it.
vote_types: Not seen in the summary JSON; the certified CSV may split by ballot type. Check before using for count order.

rules.applies: offices under Initiative 83 (the Board's HasPublishedRCV flag)
rules.note: 2026 is the first general with ranked choice for some offices (scout).

ranked_choice: First choices on the night; rounds when the Board publishes them.

certify.body: the District of Columbia Board of Elections
certify.rule: Not in the source read (NCSL's table covers the states only); to confirm from the Board's own calendar.
certify.source: The Board's results site (scout, 2026-10-09); certification date not yet read
certify.confirm: Certification date to be read from the Board's own calendar before it is printed.

rehearsal: 2024-General-Election (certified), kept in election_cache/replay/sources/<code>-<id>/ (kept 2026-10-10 by N10 for rehearsals)
scout_plan: Live-readable. Read getElectionResultsId in late October for the Nov 3 UrlText, then poll getElectionInfo and getCityWide every 3 minutes on the night, getWardPrecinct and GetANC less often. Ranked-choice rounds, where published, need their own display. DC needs a candidate list and district shapes (wards, ANC single-member districts) before its map can show local results.
notes: Reader (N10, 2026-10-10): dc_boe. check() reads getElectionInfo; fetch() it and getCityWide. Over and under votes are not candidates.
to_do: Run `python run_night.py discover` from Oct 20 for the Nov 3 UrlText; then put it in election.nov3_id.
The District has no races on the ballot lists (neither ballot database holds one), so its contests are read and checked but listed, not shown, until a District candidate list is loaded.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
